# Commonweave

Commonweave is a public-interest directory and framework for finding cooperative, commons-based, civic, rural, and community-owned institutions that solve material problems.

Canonical site: https://commonweave.earth/

Key pages:
- https://commonweave.earth/ - project overview and current public static snapshot
- https://commonweave.earth/directory.html - searchable directory
- https://commonweave.earth/map.html - geocoded map view
- https://commonweave.earth/doc.html?file=DIRECTORY - published directory document

Current data caveat:
- The public static export is an April 2026 snapshot.
- The recovered working database is newer and may differ from live static counts until the next rebuild.
- Tier A is reserved for manually reviewed entries and is currently empty.
- Tier B is registry-backed or source-backed.
- Tier C is inferred and should not be treated as verified.

Use policy:
- Public web pages and published public datasets are safe to read and cite with the caveats above.
- Do not treat inferred directory entries as verified facts.
- Do not expose sensitive rural, Indigenous, migrant, land-defense, mutual-aid, or informal groups beyond their public presence without human review.
